guidance.detail: FY27 operating income $850-880m maintained; Q2 FY27 operating income $192-197m (sequentially down). The thesis expected a firming or raise ('the CEO called the guide a floor'); it was only held, with language about working to exceed it. Street's Q2 number not found.

call.detail: Call at 10:00 ET, not yet held: it lands during the session, exactly at a 10:00 exit. Release tone is bullish (bookings, pricing, 'actions to exceed' FY27/FY29 targets), so the call is more likely to defend the guide than cut it, but the market evidently wanted a raise.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions or press coverage of this morning's print found in the time available; one search returned only older items.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 317.0 vs prev close 368.16 (-13.9%), past the 12.9% implied move and far from my frozen +4% read; 32 prints, 15 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:14, not stale. The pre-market high of 368.16 equals the prior close (likely an early print before the release). Market down about 0.9% (SPY). The market is punishing a held rather than raised guide and a down-sequential Q2 guide far harder than the release text supports in my reading; the gap between my read and the tape is about 18 points, which I read as an overshoot to the downside, with low confidence because I did not find what the street's Q2/FY bar was.

thesis_check.note: Demand confirmed (bookings +23% q/q, CEO says pricing strengthening), but the guide firming the panel leaned on did not come: FY27 held, Q2 guided down sequentially, FCF negative.

expected.open_lag_note: An active pre-market (15 prints in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:14) usually opens where it trades, so the open should hold most of the -13.9%. A gap beyond the implied move tends to give part back in the first half hour, and the bullish release text and a 10:00 call that will likely defend the guide lean the same way; the bmo prior that repricing continues argues against, hence only a modest lean toward a fade.

recommendation.limit_basis: About 45% of the way back from the pre-market reference (317) to yesterday's close (368.16), inside the pre-market range (313-368.16): reachable if the 10:00 call reassures on the guide and the gap, already past the 12.9% implied move, partly refills. Unfilled, the position goes at the close.
recommendation.reason: De koers staat voorbeurs bijna 14% lager, meer dan de opties verwachtten, terwijl de cijfers zelf (winst boven verwachting, sterke orders in de luchtvaart) eerder een lichte stijging rechtvaardigen; de teleurstelling zit in een jaarprognose die alleen werd herhaald en een zwakkere prognose voor het tweede kwartaal. Verkoop niet in de paniek van de opening, maar zet een verkooplimiet op 340 dollar voor het geval de toelichting van het management om 10:00 een deel van de daling terugwint; wordt die niet bereikt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot weg.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 verder wegzakt onder 313 dollar of er analisten met verlaagde koersdoelen of een verlaging van de jaarprognose naar buiten komen, dan direct bij de opening verkopen.
